headline: Akash Infra Projects files AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Akash Infra Projects Limited has submitted the scrutinizer report and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Routine compliance filings of this nature have minimal impact on the company's daily stock performance. Indian retail investors holding micro-cap stocks can use such disclosures to track corporate governance and resolution outcomes.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on share price.
